captures.description: 'Operative captioning refers to using text or captions as an active, generative layer to define and control an image's meaning, rather than just describing it.' Expanded distinguishes two senses: 'Operative Semiotics (Arts & Theory)' — framework where 'the caption doesn't just describe a picture; it directs how the viewer perceives and interprets the image's meaning'; and 'Human-Assisted AI (Robotics)' — task for AI/robotic systems to verbalize next steps. Operative semiotics meaning present but blended.
